items.title: Ukraine meldet mindestens 24 Tote bei Angriff in Region Saporischschja
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff in der Region Saporischschja sind der Ukraine zufolge mindestens 24 Menschen getötet worden. Präsident Selenskyj warf Moskau gezieltes Bombardement vor - demnach traf die Attacke ein Verteilzentrum für Hilfsgüter.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia region declares Day of Mourning for victims of Komyshuvakha attack
items.teaser: November 3 has been declared a Day of Mourning in the Zaporizhzhia region for those killed in the attack on Komyshuvakha earlier this morning.

items.title: Ukraine: Dutzende Tote bei russischem Luftangriff
items.teaser: Mindestens 24 Menschen sind bei einem Angriff in der Region Saporischschja gestorben. Selenskyj wirft Russland gezieltes Bombardieren einer Ausgabestelle für humanitäre Hilfe vor.

items.title: Bereits 24 Tote nach russischem Bombenangriff auf Schule in Komyschuwacha
items.teaser: In Komyschuwacha, Region Saporischschja, ist die Zahl der Todesopfer nach russischen Angriffen auf eine Bildungseinrichtung am 2. November auf 24 gestiegen.

items.title: Extremismus - Jugendliche wegen möglicher Anschlagspläne gegen Flüchtlingsheime in Verdacht
items.teaser: Die Strafverfolgungsbehörden in Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein ermitteln gegen zwei junge Männer wegen der möglichen Vorbereitung eines Anschlags.

items.title: Some Oleshky residents remain seeking evacuation, others still on the road to Ukraine, Lubinets says
items.teaser: The exact number of people still remaining in Oleshky cannot currently be verified, Lubinets said, answering a question from the Kyiv Independent. Ukraine also cannot reveal the number of evacuees as stipulated by an agreement with Russia, he added.

items.title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlich rechtsextremem Anschlagsplan
items.teaser: Gewaltfantasien gegen Migranten und konkrete Anschlagspläne: Zwei junge Männer haben sich in Chatnachrichten ausgetauscht und sind ins Visier der Ermittler geraten. Ein 15-Jähriger sitzt jetzt in Untersuchungshaft.

items.title: Polizei verhindert mutmaßlich rechtsextremen Anschlag in Niedersachsen
items.teaser: Chatnachrichten, die dem NDR vorliegen, zeigen, wie konkret die Pläne offenbar schon waren. Nach Hinweisen griff die Polizei ein. Ein Jugendlicher sitzt in U-Haft.

items.title: Ukrainian Congress Committee of America urge Governor Hochul to help block 140,000-ton Russian diesel shipment bound for Port of New York on 6-7 November
items.teaser: With Russian fuel flowing back to US ports, Ukrainian-Americans protest from New York to Rome against the diesel deal.

items.title: Ukraine to see temperatures ranging from 0°C to +15°C on Tuesday
items.teaser: Cloudy weather is expected across Ukraine on Tuesday, November 3, with no significant precipitation forecast.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russian bomb strikes kill 24 at humanitarian aid center in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 2: Russian bomb strikes kill 24 at humanitarian aid center in Zaporizhzhia Oblast Air raid alerts disrupt Ukrainian shopping malls for record one-third of operating hours in October Russia adapts decoy drone for one-way attacks at ranges of up to 1,200 kilometers, HUR says Su-57

items.title: Russische Besatzer griffen Region Dnipropetrowsk mehr als 40 Mal an, es gibt Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Besatzungstruppen attackierten drei Landkreise der Region Dnipropetrowsk mehr als 40 Mal mit Drohnen und beschossen mit Artillerie. Eine Person wurde getötet, drei weitere wurden verletzt, meldete der Leiter der Militärverwaltung der Region Dnipropetrowsk, Oleksandr Ganscha, auf Telegram.

items.title: Confrontation involving National Guard soldiers unfolds near Kyiv, police deny hostage reports
items.teaser: Videos circulating on social media appear to show a tense standoff, with people demanding access to the building.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on School in Komyshuvakha rises to 24
items.teaser: The death toll from Russian strikes on an educational institution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, on November 2 has risen to 24.

items.title: Some American media figures are “directly or indirectly” financed by Russia, says Trump-linked blogger Loomer
items.teaser: Russia directly or indirectly finances many US media figures, she claims.

items.title: 'Exceptionally horrific strike' — Russian bombs strike school used as humanitarian aid center in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, killing 24
items.teaser: Following the initial strike, Russian forces dropped another nine aerial bombs on a shelter where people were taking refuge, Zelensky said.

items.title: Luftverteidigung schießt ab/neutralisiert binnen des Tages 139 Drohnen und acht Banderol-Raketen
items.teaser: Binnen des Tages des 2. November griffen russische Streitkräfte die Ukraine mit 171 Kampfdrohnen verschiedener Typen an, darunter 103 reaktiven, sowie mit zehn S-8000 Banderol/Dan-T-Raketen. Die ukrainische Luftverteidigung schoss 139 Drohnen und acht Raketen ab oder neutralisierte sie.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 139 drones, eight 'Banderol' missiles during Russian daytime attack
items.teaser: On November 2, Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 171 attack drones of various types, including 103 jet-powered drones, as well as 10 S8000 "Banderol/Dan-T" missiles. Ukraine's Air Defence Forces shot down or suppressed 139 drones and eight missiles.

items.title: Polish security forces prepare for possible sabotage on border with Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast
items.teaser: Polish police, armed forces and security services have stepped up preventive measures in two border voivodeships following intelligence warnings of possible sabotage and armed incursions from Russia.

items.title: Russen werfen auf Schule in Komyschuwacha Gleitbomben ab, 18 Menschen getötet, unter Trümmern 27 Menschen
items.teaser: 18 Menschen wurden am 2. November in Komyschuwacha (eine Siedlung städtischen Typs im Süden der ukrainischen Region Saporischschja) infolge russischer Angriffe getötet, fünf weitere verletzt.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive bomb attacks on Komyshuvakha, killing 18 people
items.teaser: Eighteen people were killed and another five injured in Russian strikes on November 2 in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Russia has attacked Ukraine with 171 drones during the day
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Air Force says air defence has downed or jammed 139 drones and eight S8000 Banderol/Dan-T cruise missiles.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times in one day, leaving one dead and three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched more than 40 drone and artillery attacks on three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: From Cannes to the presidency: France's new right-wing contender
items.teaser: Governing France would be an entirely different ball game for the mayor of Cannes.

items.title: Zelenskyy's defence tech adviser announces protective "dome" over Kyiv that interferes with Shahed radio communications – photos
items.teaser: Hundreds of sites across Kyiv have been equipped with antennas and electronic warfare systems to interfere with the mesh radio links used by Russian drone operators to control Shaheds remotely, presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov has said.

items.title: Days before the EU grades Ukraine, watchdogs flag trouble with a condition Brussels set for its membership
items.teaser: The coalition’s report, released ahead of the Commission’s 4 November assessment, also lists NABU staff suspended, charged, and detained.

items.title: Russian attacks in Kherson region leave seven injured throughout day
items.teaser: Seven people were injured in Russian attacks in the Kherson region throughout the day. Russian forces used multiple-launch rocket systems, tube artillery and various types of drones.

items.title: Twenty-four killed in Russian aerial bomb attack on school used to distribute humanitarian aid in Zaporizhzhia Oblast – photos, video
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a school used to distribute humanitarian aid in Komyshuvakha, then dropped nine more bombs on a shelter. Five people were injured and a search for survivors is ongoing, Zelenskyy says.

items.title: Neonazi (15) in Haft: Antifa will Anschlag in Winsen verhindert haben
items.teaser: In einer Chatgruppe schreiben Neonazis von einem geplanten Anschlag. Nach einer Hausdurchsuchung eskaliert die Lage, und ein 15-Jähriger zieht mit einem Benzinkanister los.

items.title: Slowakei schleißt sich der Koalition für Rückholung der von Russland verschleppten ukrainischen Kindern an
items.teaser: Die Slowakei hat sich der Internationalen Koalition für die Rückholung ukrainischer Kinder angeschlossen.

items.title: (Not) PTSD: The Ukrainian experience
Kremlin rules out further humanitarian operations like Oleshky evacuation for now
items.teaser: Meanwhile, President Volodymyr Zelensky said in an interview with Fox News that Ukraine would welcome further humanitarian ceasefires in other parts of the front line.

items.title: Russian Defense Ministry to propose delaying troop salary payments, media reports
items.teaser: The Joint Group of Forces, the command currently fighting in Ukraine, would be exempted from the rule and receive their December pay before the new year, Verstka said.

items.title: 'Flash' explains how electronic warfare shield created over Kyiv
items.teaser: The operation to protect Kyiv from remotely controlled jet-powered Shahed drones using electronic warfare systems forced Russian forces to upgrade their drones and look for alternative solutions.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strikes on Izium rises to 27, one killed
items.teaser: Twenty-seven people were injured in Russian strikes on the city of Izium in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Putin has ordered private data centres to allocate capacity for state, says Reuters
items.teaser: Private data centre owners in Russia must reserve 10% of their capacity for state use under a new decree signed by Russian leader Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Edited Volume on Battlefield Forensics
items.teaser: The post Edited Volume on Battlefield Forensics appeared first on Völkerrechtsblog .

items.title: Ukrainian journalists urge global media not to look away from Russian aggression
items.teaser: "Fellow journalists, do everything in your power to prevent your countries from siding with evil," Ukrainian journalists said in a joint video appeal to their international colleagues.

items.title: Air raid alerts shut Ukrainian malls for record one-third of opening hours in October
items.teaser: The alerts accounted for 32.5% of their operating time, up 1.7% from September and almost three times the share recorded a year earlier, according to the Ukrainian Council of Shopping Centers (UCSC).

items.title: How did Vienna become safe haven for oligarchs and fugitives?
items.teaser: The detention of Ukraine's best-known investigative journalist, Mykhailo Tkach, and his cameraman Yaroslav Bondarenko in Vienna this October caused an understandable outcry in both Ukraine and Austria. items.title: Russia adapts decoy drone for one-way attacks at ranges of up to 1,200 kilometers, HUR says
items.teaser: According to a technical breakdown published by HUR, the new version, called the Gerbera-2, has a range of 1,200 kilometers and carries a 25-kilogram warhead.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attack on Chuhuiv rises to seven
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian strikes on the city of Chuhuiv in the Kharkiv region has risen to seven.

items.title: No one would dare exclude Ukraine from World Championship elite division, former ice hockey official says
items.teaser: Kalervo Kummola, former vice president of the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF), is confident that Russia will not take Ukraine's place in the elite division of the 2027 World Championship.

items.title: Two boys, 4 and 10, injured in Russian artillery strike on Nikopol
items.teaser: Two children have been injured and a house damaged in a Russian artillery strike on the city of Nikopol in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

items.title: Lubinets explains movement of Russian military equipment during ceasefire in Oleshky
items.teaser: Russian military equipment, captured on video during the ceasefire in the Kherson region, was being used for demining operations and was moving under the control of the Ukrainian side.

items.title: “40% is an argument. The weightiest”: Ukrainian top brigade commander says drone units soar once allowed to buy what they need
items.teaser: Colonel Kyrylo Veres says standing up the Unmanned Systems Forces in 2024 is paying off.

items.title: Temporary ceasefire enables evacuation of 173 people from 10 communities in Kherson region
items.teaser: A total of 173 residents were evacuated from 10 dangerous communities on the right bank of the Kherson region during a temporary ceasefire. Among those rescued were 24 people with limited mobility and 21 children. No minors remain in the village of Stanislav or the city of Beryslav.

items.title: Slovakia joins coalition for return of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia
items.teaser: Slovakia has joined the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children, handing over a diplomatic note to the ambassadors of Ukraine and Canada.

items.title: "He devoted many years to saving animals": Veterinarian Serhii Huzenkov killed in Russian attack on Kyiv on 30 October
items.teaser: Serhii Huzenkov, a vet who worked at the Kyiv City Veterinary Medicine Hospital in the Podilskyi district, was killed in a Russian attack on Kyiv on 30 October.

items.title: Game of Thrones star Nikolaj Coster-Waldau calls for increased support for Ukraine’s energy sector
items.teaser: During his visit to Ukraine, Danish actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, a Goodwill Ambassador for the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), called on international partners to continue providing financial support to Ukrainian communities and to help restore energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2, injure over 30 across Ukraine over past day as 10 regions face power outages
items.teaser: The power supply situation was most difficult in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts following Russian attacks, the Energy Ministry said.

items.title: Russen beschießen Nikopol mit Artillerie, zwei Kinder verletzt
items.teaser: Russische Besatzungstruppen haben Nikopol in der Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Artillerie beschossen, zwei Kinder wurden dabei verletzt.

items.title: Cooperation with Trump and end to military aid for Ukraine: Germany's AfD unveils policy papers
items.teaser: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has presented policy papers confirming its close ties with US President Donald Trump and demanding an end to support for Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine’s MFA rejects Mali, Niger accusations that Ukraine supports illegal armed groups
items.teaser: Ukraine firmly rejects accusations by Mali and Niger that it allegedly supports illegal armed groups and interferes in the internal affairs of Sahel states.

items.title: Starlink’s slowdown hurt Ukraine at front. Now Kyiv and Türkiye weigh building satellite technology together, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Talks with Türkiye have begun, Zelenskyy says after meeting Turkish leader Erdogan.

items.title: Lubinets: Ukraine will not disclose number of citizens evacuated from Oleshky
items.teaser: Ukraine will not release official figures on the number of citizens who have returned from Oleshky to territory controlled by Ukraine, or on those who have left for territory controlled by Russia, in accordance with agreements reached with the Russian side.

items.title: UK intercepts Russian spy ship monitoring NATO military exercises
items.teaser: British helicopters tracked a Russian intelligence ship, Viktor Leonov, as it was "closely monitoring" NATO military drills off the coast of Scotland, the Royal Navy said.

items.title: Ukraine turns old BTR into rolling bomb — then drove it straight into Russian lines, battalion commander says
items.teaser: A soldier once walked for days to fetch ammunition under watching drones.

items.title: Lubinets says further steps being prepared for humanitarian missions involving Russia: Ombudsmen appeal to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Ukrainian Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights Dmytro Lubinets has appealed to Melania Trump to extend the positive experience of Oleshky to other settlements.

items.title: Wie viele Menschen in Oleschky verblieben sind, lässt sich nicht feststellen – Lubinez
items.teaser: Es ist derzeit unmöglich, die genaue Anzahl der in Oleschky verbliebenen Personen festzustellen.

items.title: Lubinets: Ukraine leaves large amount of humanitarian aid in Oleshky for residents who remain in city
items.teaser: Ukraine has provided substantial humanitarian aid to the people who remained in Oleshky—food, water, medicine, fuel for generators, and specialized equipment for the hospital, which continues to operate in the city.

items.title: “By blocking Moldova, no one is helping Ukraine,” President Maia Sandu says, as both countries wait to open their two EU negotiation clusters
items.teaser: Moldova’s president stops short of splitting her EU bid from Ukraine’s, but says she answers for her own country’s progress.

items.title: Minefields kill 279 Russian troops on southern front in October – military
items.teaser: In October, Russian forces lost 279 servicemen and 60 pieces of weapons and military equipment after triggering mine and explosive barriers in the Huliaipole, Orikhiv and Oleksandrivka sectors of the front.

items.title: AfD und Linke: Warum Extremismus-Vergleiche zu kurz greifen
items.teaser: SPD und Grüne laufen Sturm gegen die Gleichsetzung von AfD und der Linken durch CDU und CSU. Experten betonen deutliche Unterschiede, vor allem bei Ideologie und Bewertung des Verfassungsschutzes. Von Jürgen P. Lang.

items.title: Russia steps up use of electronic warfare systems to disrupt Starlink in Crimea and on front line
items.teaser: Radio technology expert Serhii Beskrestnov has detailed how Russian troops camouflage Starlink-jamming equipment across Crimea and active combat zones

items.title: Russian drone attack on residential area in Sumy district kills one and injures another
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a drone attack on a residential area in the Mykolaiv community of the Sumy district; one person was killed and another was seriously injured.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief on talks with Russian counterpart: "I know no other way to bring back our citizens"
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, Ukrainian Parliamentary Human Rights Commissioner, has explained why he maintains diplomatic etiquette in negotiations with his Russian counterpart, Yana Lantratova.

items.title: Ukraine, EU split over US-backed plan to bring Russian gas back to Europe
items.teaser: The European Union is unlikely to accept a U.S. proposal to resume Russian gas deliveries to Europe through Ukraine, EU officials told the Kyiv Independent, despite Washington's belief that the scheme could help secure a ceasefire and provide economic benefits to Kyiv. items.teaser: Die Strafverfolgungsbehörden in Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein ermitteln gegen einen Jugendlichen und einen jungen Mann wegen der möglichen Vorbereitung eines Anschlags.

items.title: Russia, accused of mass torture, withdraws from convention against torture
items.teaser: Committee President Alan Mitchell has lamented the end of the CPT's monitoring mandate as Russia's official denunciation of the treaty takes effect.

items.title: WSJ: US pitches Russian gas through Ukraine’s pipelines as Moscow’s incentive for an energy truce
items.teaser: Kyiv let Russian transit expire in January 2025. The EU’s full ban on Russian pipeline gas starts in autumn 2027.

items.title: Bodies of military personnel, civilians taken out of Oleshky during humanitarian mission – Lubinets
items.teaser: The bodies of deceased Ukrainian citizens, both military personnel and civilians, were taken out of Oleshky and nearby areas during the humanitarian mission.

items.title: Ukraine's human rights commissioner explains why people were not evacuated from Oleshky directly to Kherson
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said that a direct river crossing was ruled out to protect frontline positions and preserve Ukraine's defence capabilities.

items.title: Schauspieler Nikolaj Coster-Waldau fordert verstärkte Unterstützung für ukrainischen Energiesektor
items.teaser: Während seines Besuchs in der Ukraine rief der UN-Sonderbotschafter des Entwicklungsprogramms (UNDP) und dänische Schauspieler Nikolaj Coster-Waldau die internationalen Partner dazu auf, die finanzielle Unterstützung für ukrainische Gemeinden fortzusetzen und beim Wiederaufbau der Energieinfrastruktur vor dem Winter zu

items.title: US delivery of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine will span 3 years starting in 2030
items.teaser: Ukraine will be able to receive the 500 Patriot PAC-3 interceptor missiles approved by the US State Department between Q4 2030 and Q4 2033

items.title: Flash: Russia increases deployment of satellite-based EW systems targeting Starlink
items.teaser: Russian occupation forces are increasing the number of satellite electronic warfare (EW) systems that interfere with Starlink operations.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief says Russian equipment seen in video was used for mine clearance
items.teaser: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said Russian heavy equipment seen in footage filmed during the Oleshky ceasefire was used exclusively for mine clearance under supervision.

items.title: One fatality, five injured in overnight fire at boarding facility near Kyiv
items.teaser: One person was found dead and five others injured in a fire at a boarding facility in the village of Sofiivska Borshchahivka, Bucha district, Kyiv region.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief says he and Russian counterpart have agreed to present joint proposal to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets and Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova propose extending the Oleshky evacuation model to other frontline settlements.

items.title: The Oleshky truce saved hundreds, but Russia used it to bring fresh troops, armor, and fuel within nine kilometers of Kherson, marines say
items.teaser: Drone footage also shows bodies being carried out of the town’s hospital under Russian soldiers’ watch, and a journalist says 47 bodies from its basement were taken to occupied Henichesk.

Russian FPV drones attack special-purpose vehicles near Kharkiv, killing one
items.teaser: A man was killed in a Russian FPV drone strike in the territory of the Malodanilivka territorial community in Kharkiv district.

items.title: “The days are long gone when EW complex looked like six trailers standing side by side”: Russia’s Starlink jammers go undercover, defense adviser says
items.teaser: Russia is building more jammers to blind Ukraine’s Starlink and hiding them. Serhii Beskrestnov suggests each covers 25 sq km and tells drone crews where to look.

items.title: Russischer Luftangriff auf Isjum: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf 15
items.teaser: Nach einem russischen Gleitbombenangriff auf die Stadt Isjum in der Region Charkiw ist die Zahl der Verletzten auf 15 gestiegen. Eine Person kam ums Leben, teilt die Militärverwaltung der Stadt auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Drones hit Russia’s Samara oil hub that blends Urals export crude—first strike there since 11 October
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff says the station blends a crude grade that makes up as much as half of Russia’s oil exports.

items.title: New support program helps farmers with demining and production recovery
items.teaser: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United Nations World Food Program (WFP), is launching a new program to support farmers.

items.title: Russian bombs strike apartment building in Sloviansk, klling one and injuring six
items.teaser: Russian forces have carried out an airstrike using two FAB-250 bombs on the city center of Sloviansk, Donetsk region. One bomb struck a multi-story apartment building, killing a woman and injuring six people.

items.title: Kyiv plans new National Guard center to recruit foreigners. Front-line commander wants it built fast: half of them still come on donations
items.teaser: Ukraine is short of soldiers, yet foreign volunteers get little state help, according to the commander.

items.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria
items.teaser: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.

items.title: Ukraine’s Armed Forces report record 2,500 Russian troops killed in one day
items.teaser: No sooner had October become the month with the highest enemy casualties since the start of Russia's invasion of Ukraine than, on November 1, the record for daily casualties was broken

items.title: HUR: Neuestes Kampfflugzeug explodiert auf Flugplatz im russischen Achhtubinsk
items.teaser: „Am 29. Oktober explodierte auf dem Gelände des russischen Militärflughafens "Achthubinsk" der modernste Mehrzweckjäger des Aggressorstaates -Su-57. Dies geschah beim Triebwerksstart. Der geschätzte Wert des Kampfflugzeugs liegt bei etwa 150 Millionen Dollar“, teilt der Militärgeheimdienst (HUR) mit.

items.title: Tender announced for 2027 food procurement for AFU
items.teaser: The Defense Procurement Agency (DOT) of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine has announced a tender for the procurement of food products for 2027 for the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the State Special Transport Service, with an estimated value of UAH 43.8 billion.

items.title: Russia officially withdraws from European Anti-Torture Convention
items.teaser: On November 1, Russia officially withdrew from the European Convention for the Prevention of Torture. As a result, the Prevention of Torture and Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (ECPT) will no longer be able to inspect places of detention in the country.

items.title: Russia exploits ceasefire to mask military movements, General Staff says
items.teaser: Russia used the humanitarian ceasefire in Oleshky to rotate soldiers, improve fighting positions, expand anti-drone netting on key logistics routes, and resupply soldiers with ammunition, Ukraine's General Staff said on Nov. 2.

items.title: Russian drone strikes facility in Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked a business in the Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region using a drone.

items.title: HUR: Eight Chinese and four US manufacturers supply parts for Russia’s upgraded Gerbera drone. One with warhead already turned up on Poland’s coast
items.teaser: Russia’s throwaway drone gets a costly upgrade: anti-jam antennas, a camera watching for interceptors, and the range to cross Ukraine’s borders.

items.title: Russisches Militär wirft Gleitbomben auf Isjum ab - es gibt einen Toten und 11 Verletzte, die Stadt ist ohne Strom
items.teaser: Am Morgen des 2. Novembers hat die russische Armee die Stadt Isjum in der Region Charkiw mit gelenkten Fliegerbomben angegriffen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleh Synehubow, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian forces strike Chuhuiv district in Kharkiv region, several people injured
items.teaser: The Russian military attacked the village of Prymorske in the Pechenihy territorial community of Chuhuiv district, injuring two people.

items.title: Ein Toter und zwei Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Komyschuwacha in Region Saporischschja
items.teaser: Russischen Truppen haben am Morgen Komyschuwacha in der Region Saporischschja angegriffen, es gibt Opfer unter der Zivilbevölkerung, wie der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Mychajlo Semikin, auf Telegram mitteilt.

items.title: Verletzte nach russischen Angriffen in Regionen Schytomyr und Odessa, zivile und Energieinfrastruktur beschädigt
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat in der Nacht zum 2. November eine Energieanlage in der Region Odessa angegriffen, teilt der Energieversorger DTEK auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukraine can buy 500 Patriot missiles, but they may arrive only in years. One estimate says they’d last about three months
items.teaser: Kyiv asked for 100 Patriot interceptors a month and wants partners to send missiles from stock now, refilled later from the order.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 205 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, Pokrowsk am stärksten umkämpft
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 205 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: Russian forces attack homes, energy, logistics infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, three injured
items.teaser: Two adults and a child were injured in Russian attacks on energy, logistics and civilian infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Ukraine’s Air Alert app was warn of radiation, chemicals, and street fighting in Kyiv. None of it was real
items.teaser: Some warnings came in Russian and invoked the Oreshnik missile. The Air Force blamed likely enemy interference.

items.title: WSJ: US pushes to resume Russian gas supplies to Europe via Ukraine

items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russia struck energy infrastructure in at least four regions overnight. Meanwhile, a Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire for the Kherson region is set to end on Sunday evening. DW has more.

items.title: Ukraine news: Oleshky ceasefire ends as Russian attacks leave tens of thousands without power
items.teaser: A US-brokered ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region ended on Sunday night with no violations reported. Elsewhere, however, Russia struck energy infrastructure in at least four other regions. DW has more.

items.title: Ukraine: Six-day localized ceasefire in Oleshky comes to end
items.teaser: A US-brokered ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region ended on Sunday night with no violations reported. But Russian drones and missiles hit other regions in Ukraine.

items.title: Unmanned Systems Forces destroy over 16,700 Russian troops in October – USF commander

items.title: One injured and building damaged in Russian attack on Chernivtsi
items.teaser: A 67-year-old man with shrapnel wounds has been hospitalised and an office building damaged in a Russian attack by three drones on Chernivtsi.

items.title: Zelensky confirms attack on Russian rocket fuel factory, missile launcher system
items.teaser: "A ‘Pantsir-S2’ system and a command and control vehicle belonging to the S-400 ‘Triumph’ system were also struck," Zelensky said, causing an estimated $70 million in damage.

items.teaser: The interceptor’s vision software detects the target, tracks it, and guides the drone home, leaving its crew mostly to manage the closing speed.

items.title: On Kramatorsk’s Peace Square, a Russian airstrike takes down the building that outlasted Russia’s 2014 occupation
items.teaser: The city government building saw the city seized by Russia in 2014 and freed again, and now a Russian airstrike has destroyed it as the front draws closer.

items.title: Pope hopes humanitarian operation in Oleshky will lead to new peace initiatives
items.teaser: Following the completion of the humanitarian mission in occupied Oleshky, Pope Leo XIV has called for renewed commitment to peace and diplomatic engagement.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV welcomes successful completion of humanitarian mission in Oleshky
items.teaser: Pope Leo XIV has welcomed the successful completion of a humanitarian mission in Oleshky, Kherson region, and expressed hope that cooperation between the parties would lead to new peace initiatives.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukrainian forces liberated more territory in October than Russian invaders seized
items.teaser: In October 2026, Ukraine's Defense Forces inflicted record losses on the Russian army since the start of the full-scale war and liberated 96.2 square kilometers of Ukrainian territory – 10.4 square kilometers more than Russian forces managed to capture during the same period.

items.title: Russian drone attack injures two people in Kyiv region, damages homes and vehicles
items.teaser: Two men were injured in a Russian drone attack in the Kyiv region in the morning of November 1.

items.title: Angriff auf Energieinfrastruktur in Region Schytomyr: Mehr als 650 Ortschaften ohne Strom
items.teaser: In der Region Schytomyr hat der Feind die Energieinfrastruktur angegriffen.

items.title: Steinmeier: China nicht bereit für Ukraine-Gipfel
items.teaser: Nach einem Treffen mit Chinas Präsident Xi kündigt der Bundespräsident mögliche Gespräche zwischen China, Russland und den USA an. Die Ukraine soll dabei jedoch kein Thema sein.

items.title: "Enough to fill 200 Moscow Metro carriages": Zelenskyy reports record Russian losses in October
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has said Russia lost 54,400 troops killed and wounded in October, its highest monthly figure since the war began, while Ukraine liberated 96.2 sq km of territory.

items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in Dnipro, causing a fire.

items.title: Russia is fighting for a border village near Kharkiv that leads it nowhere. What it is after is fewer Ukrainian troops in Donbas
items.teaser: Pressure on the Kharkiv and Sumy borders has moved the line only a few kilometers, but Ukrainian commanders say it aims to tie down Ukrainian forces in the north while Russia attacks in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Drone technologies and countermeasures to develop in parallel in coming years – defense company CEO
items.teaser: Unmanned aerial vehicle technologies and countermeasures will continue to develop in parallel over the coming years, constantly adapting to each other.

items.title: EU Commission backs Poland government over constitutional court crisis
items.teaser: "The appointment of eight new members of the Constitutional Tribunal lies within the constitutional power of the Sejm (Poland's parliament)," a European Commission spokesperson told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Three Russian refineries hit since Friday handle roughly 10% of Russia’s refining and over 10% of its diesel
items.teaser: Kstovo, Novokuibyshevsk, and Ufa together process tens of millions of tons of crude a year, and the newest fire is at the biggest of the three.

items.title: Russians enter team from occupied Luhansk in Russian Ice Hockey Federation competition
items.teaser: Russia has entered an ice hockey team from occupied Luhansk in a competition as part of its continued attempts to integrate Ukraine's occupied territories into its own sports system.

items.title: Ghana claims Putin has banned recruitment of its citizens to fight against Ukraine, Reuters says
items.teaser: Ghana's foreign minister claims Putin has banned the recruitment of Ghanaians to fight against Ukraine, but Moscow has not confirmed the agreement reached at the Russia-Africa Summit.

items.title: Drones violate Moldovan airspace twice during massive Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: Two drones were detected in Moldovan airspace on Saturday, October 31, amid a massive Russian attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 1, injure 47 over past day, leaving hundreds of thousands without electricity
items.teaser: Russia continued its campaign against Ukraine's energy grid ahead of winter, targeting infrastructure in at least four regions overnight and injuring three workers from the Ukrainian energy company DTEK.

items.title: G20-Gipfel: Trump sieht „kein Problem“ bei Selenskyj-Einladung
items.teaser: Der US-Präsident hat zu verstehen gegeben, dass er Wolodymyr Selenskyj zum G20-Gipfel einladen wird, der Mitte Dezember in Miami stattfindet.

items.title: Zelensky reports strikes on Russian defense industry plant, air defense assets worth $70 million
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Kamensky chemical plant in Russia’s Rostov region, which is involved in missile production, as well as a Pantsir-S2 air defense system and a command-and-staff vehicle of the S-400 Triumf system. The total value of the air defense assets hit is estimated at approximately $70 million.

items.title: Russia to build 2GW nuclear power plant in Ghana, Reuters reports
items.teaser: Ghana says Russia will help build a 2,000-megawatt nuclear plant, announced at the Russia-Africa Summit.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages homes, warehouse and vehicles in Lviv community
items.teaser: Russian drone attacks have damaged residential buildings, a warehouse and vehicles in the Lviv community.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukrainian forces have struck Russian air defence assets worth US$70m and missile factory
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has said Ukrainian forces struck a Pantsir-S2 and an S-400 command post vehicle worth about US$70 million, plus the Kamensky Plant in Rostov Oblast.

items.title: Russia launches nearly 2,000 attack drones, over 1,500 guided bombs, 44 missiles at Ukraine in one week – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia launched 1,940 attack drones, more than 1,580 guided aerial bombs and 44 missiles of various types, including 36 ballistic missiles, at Ukraine over the past week.

items.title: Wadephul erwartet baldige Einigung über Schwarzmeer-Getreideexporte
items.teaser: Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul hofft, dass in den kommenden Wochen ein Ergebnis beim Getreideexport aus der Ukraine und Russland über das Schwarze Meer erzielt werden kann.

items.title: Five injured, including teenager, in Russian attacks on Poltava and Rivne oblasts
items.teaser: Russian drones injured five people, including a 14-year-old, and damaged houses in Poltava Oblast's Reshetylivka hromada and Rivne Oblast's Ostroh district.

items.title: Child injured in Russian drone attack in Poltava region
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian drone damaged a house in the Reshetylivka community in the Poltava region, injuring a child.

items.title: Russian forces stepping up efforts to expand control in northern Kharkiv region, border guards say
items.teaser: Russian troops are making the strongest efforts to expand their area of control in the northern Kharkiv region. In the Chernihiv region, however, they currently lack sufficient forces to launch such attacks.

items.title: Man, 84, walks 6 km to escape Kherson
items.teaser: An 84-year-old man from Kherson has walked almost 6 km (nearly 4 miles) to leave the city, where he had been living in isolation for six months because of Russian attacks.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia has attacked energy infrastructure in four oblasts, leaving hundreds of thousands of families without power
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said Russian attacks on substations and power lines in four oblasts left hundreds of thousands of households without electricity; he also called for faster Patriot deliveries.

items.title: Russian attack sets house ablaze in Rivne region, injuring four
items.teaser: A house caught fire in the Ostroh district of the Rivne region following a Russian attack, leaving four people injured.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 371 von 433 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 371 von 433 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 31. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Russia suffers record troop losses in October, its worst month since full-scale invasion, Ukraine says
items.teaser: According to the data from the General Staff, Russia's estimated losses reached 54,400 soldiers in October.

items.title: USA warnen Russland vor Anschlag in Moskau – Putin-Regime reagiert
items.teaser: Die USA warnen den Kreml vor einem möglichen Terrorakt. Das Putin-Regime kündigt daraufhin an, "angemessene" Maßnahmen seien ergriffen worden.

items.title: Russia attacks asphalt plant in Uman
items.teaser: A Russian UAV crashed on the grounds of an asphalt plant in Uman, Cherkasy Oblast, on the morning of 1 November.

items.title: Russian drone attacks damage energy facilities in Kyiv region, injure woman
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked the Kyiv region over the course of the day, with damage reported in six districts and a woman injured.

items.title: Romania scrambles four fighter jets due to drone incursion
items.teaser: Romania sent four F-16s and a helicopter after two drones entered its airspace on 31 October, triggering alerts in six counties; no crashes reported.

items.title: Russen töten Zivilisten in Region Donezk, acht weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer haben am 31. Oktober einen Menschen in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Russian forces strike energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, leaving over 650 settlements without power
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, leaving more than 650 settlements without electricity.

items.title: Ukraine: Zehn Tage gegen den Krieg im Kopf
items.teaser: In den ukrainischen Karpaten versuchen Soldatinnen und Soldaten, für ein paar Tage Abstand vom Krieg zu gewinnen. Doch die Erinnerungen lassen sich nicht einfach abschütteln. Von Susanne Petersohn.

items.title: Debris from Russian drones damages power lines, educational facility in Kirovohrad region
items.teaser: Debris from Russian drones have damaged power lines, an educational facility and agricultural warehouses in the Kirovohrad region.

items.title: Mobile phone mast and apartment blocks damaged in Vinnytsia, energy infrastructure hit in oblast
items.teaser: A large-scale Russian attack on Vinnytsia Oblast hit energy facilities and damaged a mobile phone mast, apartment block windows and other civilian sites.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Vinnytsia region, damage mobile communications tower
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Vinnytsia region overnight, damaging a mobile communications tower.

items.title: Drohnen greifen Lukoil-Raffinerie in Russland an
items.teaser: Infolge des Drohnenangriffs auf die Region Nischni Nowgorod in der Nacht zum 1. November wurde ein Industrieunternehmen im Rayon Kstowskij erheblich beschädigt.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,590,270 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,100 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Drones attack Lukoil refinery in Russia
items.teaser: An industrial facility in the Kstovo district sustained significant damage in a drone attack on Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region overnight on November 1.

items.title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in Kyiv and Zhytomyr oblasts
items.teaser: Russian attacks on energy facilities left over 650 Zhytomyr Oblast settlements without electricity and damaged infrastructure in six Kyiv Oblast districts.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 260 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: Am 31. Oktober kam es zu 240 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: War update: 264 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
items.teaser: A total of 264 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded on the front line on October 31.

items.title: Nearly 100,000 consumers remain without power in Dnipropetrovsk region following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Nearly 100,000 consumers in the Dnipropetrovsk region remain without electricity following Russian attacks.

items.title: Bulgarians vote in highly polarized presidential runoff overshadowed by Ukraine war
items.teaser: Voters in Bulgaria are choosing between two candidates with vastly different views of the war in Ukraine and ties with Russia. The runoff comes after a record-low turnout in the first round.

items.title: Ukrainian drone forces commander reports monthly record: one target hit every 41 seconds
items.teaser: Unmanned Systems Forces commander Brovdi says units hit 64,807 targets in October and inflicted a record 16,796 Russian personnel losses.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2100 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 1. November 2026 bei rund 1.590.270 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2100 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,100 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 1, 2026, have reached approximately 1,590,270 personnel, including 2,100 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 371 of 433 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 371 out of the 433 drones used by Russian troops to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 31.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 699 times in past 24 hours, six injured
items.teaser: Russian troops launched 699 attacks on 55 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Six people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.
